0022600194.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-5, 12th in the West and 4.5 games behind for third in the Pacific) host the Houston Rockets (7-2, first in the Southwest) while on a four-game losing streak and with a 1-2 home record. The Suns are missing Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), all out, while the Rockets are without Steven Adams (calf strain), who is out, and Clint Capela (ankle sprain), who is day-to-day with a game-time decision. There are no games yet between the teams this season, but the Suns lost 0-4 to Houston in the 2025-26 season series, and their last meeting, in Phoenix on April 7, 2026, ended in a 119-105 Suns loss.
